correctness.rationale: Write all nine alternating structure constants for the second bracket, fixing [x,y]=z. Mixed Jacobi is exactly g=e; Jacobi for second operation becomes eu+dv=hu+ev=bu+av=0 after u=f−a,v=b−i; coefficient c is free. This is the complete necessary-and-sufficient incidence Mw=0 with M rows (e,d),(h,e),(b,a) and w=(u,v). The w=0 branch A6 is closed, while w≠0 is a rank-three vector bundle over A²\{0}, irreducible dimension 5. Its closure intersects the zero branch at rank(M)≤1 (dimension 4). They are distinct geometric components, and cut-and-paste gives [X]=L6+L5−L3, hence q6+q5−q3 rational points and zeta (1−q³T)/((1−q⁵T)(1−q⁶T)). Independent symbolic Jacobi and finite q=3,5,7 exhaustions yielded 945,18625,134113 and exact strata counts 216,3000,16464 and intersections 99,725,2695. Result is for reduced variety, char ≠2; checks are finite support not proof.
